record.name: fanbasis
record.one_liner: A creator economy platform that bundles digital products, subscriptions, courses, communities, and payments into one dashboard.
record.access_note: Sign up for a creator account on the platform dashboard to generate API keys.
record.api_note: Covers subscriptions, payments, members, and digital products.
record.blocker_note: The platform operates on transaction fees or revenue shares on sales.

evidence.quote: Commas (formerly FanBasis) is a platform for online creators and entrepreneurs to create and sell products
Create an API key. To do this, go to Account > API Keys.
One place to create, sell, and get paid, with payments built in.
FanBasis's data structures, including subscriptions, payments, members, digital products
This project implements an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server in Python.
Create an API key. To do this, go to Account > API Keys.
